events.title: Update archive — August and September 2026
events.summary: Inspectors, Every investigation starts somewhere. This archive brings together the first Stick Crisis releases on Steam and the changes that did not yet have their own notes in this news hub. This is a retrospective archive, not a new build or the full game’s launch announcement. Each release date appears below. The full game remains in beta. events.title: Demo & beta update — abilities, combat and saves
events.summary: Beta — October 19, 2026 (build 26056011) Successful ability upgrades recharge the ability immediately, including during the rewards pause. The HUD updates at once and active effects finish normally. Improved enemy visibility, wave entry placement and repositioning when cover blocks a shot. Fixed reused projectiles, weapon changes and reloading at phase startup. Grenade explosions have a short, controlled camera shake. Simultaneous saves no longer collide over a shared temporary file. events.title: Demo & beta update — graphics, controls and feedback
events.summary: Beta update — October 10, 2026 (build 25853611) Fixed unintended brightness, graphics quality, render scale and resolution resets when loading saves without valid graphics settings, including when opening the shop after level results. Damaged settings recover without clearing progress. Added an adjustable mouse aiming pointer: 75%, 100%, 125%, 150% and 200%, available in Controls from the main and pause menus. events.title: Stick Crisis 0.17.0-beta — New scenery and Inspector improvements
events.summary: Refreshed scenery and cover A richer military Tutorial with character-scale buildings, new crates and sandbags. Street brings back detailed New York night streets and refreshed cover. Jungle adds ground vegetation, clearer visual hierarchy, and refined crates and logs. Desert features new scenery and sandbag, rock and jeep artwork.
